estimates.assumptions: 3 medium potatoes ≈ 450g total raw weight, skin-on, edible portion only (USDA raw potato values: ~15.2g carb, ~1.8g fiber per 100g)
1 tbs olive oil = 14g, all used in cooking (pure fat, zero carbs)
2 strips bacon ≈ 60g raw, pan-fried, fat rendered and partially absorbed by potatoes (meat has negligible carbs)
1 medium garlic clove, minced ≈ 3g (USDA: ~33g carb, ~2.1g fiber per 100g)
1 tbs maple syrup = 20g (USDA: ~67g carb per 100g, fiber negligible)
parsley garnish quantity too small and unspecified to estimate reliably
pinch of salt has zero carbohydrates
pinch of pepper ≈ 0.3g (USDA: ~64g carb, ~25g fiber per 100g; negligible but included)
allspice to taste quantity too small and unspecified to estimate reliably
